name: futrix-ai
description: Futrix AI Career Twin - monorepo root

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "PYTHON,NODE,REACT" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,magenta" "npm run dev:python" "npm run dev:node" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:log: concurrently --kill-others --names "PYTHON,NODE,REACT" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,yellow.bold,magenta.bold" --timestamp-format "HH:mm:ss" -t "npm run dev:python" "npm run dev:node" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: cd node-api && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.test:client: cd client && npm run build && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:node && npm run test:client
